text: a snowy december and i just made warm hot chocolate
rain on the window and nowhere to be
driving home at 2am with the windows down
the first warm day of spring and i skipped my lecture to sit in the park
cleaning out my grandmother's apartment after the funeral
waiting at the gate for a flight that keeps getting delayed
we stayed up talking on the roof until the sky went grey
sunday morning, coffee, and the whole day with nothing planned
i finally quit the job that was making me miserable
a humid night market full of smoke and neon and strangers laughing
